in_marathi.name: Gore
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fierce, Brave Warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gore हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gore is believed to have originated from the Sanskrit word 'krodha', meaning anger or wrath. In Hindu mythology, it was the name of a fierce warrior who possessed immense strength and bravery. The name is often given to boys in the belief that it will bestow upon them the courage and valor of the ancient warrior.
